scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.check:types: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit --pretty false && npm run build:packages && tsc -p packages/presentation/tsconfig.worklet.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/presentation/tsconfig.worker.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/wasm-adapters/tsconfig.worker.json --pretty false && tsc -p test/lab/tsconfig.json --pretty false && vue-tsc -p apps/vue-player/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:assets && npm run build -w @ubve/vue-player
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:qualification
scripts.test:codecs: npm run build:packages && npm run build:codecs && node --test test/codec-lifecycle.test.mjs test/codecs-node.evidence.mjs && npm run test:codecs:modern
scripts.test:disc: tsc -b packages/disc packages/io-demux --pretty false && node --test test/disc.test.mjs test/mp4-index.test.mjs
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/core packages/testkit packages/io-demux packages/wasm-adapters packages/native-bridge packages/presentation packages/disc packages/browser --pretty false
scripts.build:assets: npm run build:codecs && npm run build:presentation && npm run build:disc && npm run build:notices && npm run support:generate && npm run check:assets
scripts.dev: npm run build:assets && npm run dev -w @ubve/vue-player
scripts.lab:build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:assets && node test/lab/build.mjs
